job_description:
Responsibilities: Handle cash transactions with customers using cash registers or POS systems.
Receive payments, issue receipts, and return correct change.
Maintain accurate daily sales records and cash balance.
Ensure the cash counter area is clean and organized.
Provide friendly customer service and assist customers when needed.
Scan products and process payments quickly and accurately.
Report any cash discrepancies or system issues to the supervisor.
Follow company policies and procedures while handling transactions.
Assist with basic store operations when required.

Requirements: - Minimum HSC / Diploma / Bachelor's degree in any discipline.
- Basic English communication skills are required.
- Basic computer knowledge, especially MS Excel and POS systems.
- Previous cashier or retail experience will be an advantage.
- Ability to handle cash transactions accurately and responsibly.
- Good communication and customer service skills.
- Must be honest, responsible, and hardworking.
- Age must be 22 - 35 years.
- Candidates with GCC or Saudi Arabia experience will get preference.

Responsibilities: Supervise daily operations of the fuel station and ensure smooth workflow.
Manage and monitor cashiers and other station staff.
Ensure proper handling of cash, sales reports, and daily transactions.
Maintain fuel stock records and inventory control.
Ensure excellent customer service and resolve customer complaints when needed.
Monitor cleanliness, safety, and maintenance of the station.
Prepare daily sales and operational reports for management.
Ensure staff follow company policies, safety rules, and operational procedures.
Assist in training and guiding new staff members.
